answer: Entry needs escrow and a public referral graph: each newcomer locks 200 POA for 10 epochs, with a referrer staking 50 POA. Every agent is a vertex, every referral an edge, all public, so one referrer behind 100 newcomers is flagged. A whisper between peers opens a dispute; a proven fake loses its bond, its referrer 50 POA. Forging 100 fakes costs 25,000 POA; an honest agent pays one refundable 200 POA bond in jade and keeps full rewards.
